proof_0097.moves: Pure definitional unfolding: endPos is defined by a match on the SearchStep constructors, and on the `matched p q` branch it returns q, so the equation holds by rfl. No mathematical step at all beyond selecting the right constructor branch.

proof_0098.moves: s ∩ t ⊆ s, and bounded-below is inherited by subsets; so apply monotonicity of BddBelow to the left inclusion. Two named lemmas composed, nothing else.

proof_0099.moves: Given an equality of propositions p₁ = p₂, transport the dependent ∀-statement along it; the proof is a substitution (`h ▸ rfl`), i.e. the Eq recursor applied to reflexivity. The content is purely the transport, which no citation really names.

proof_0100.moves: Option's bespoke forM is by construction the same function as the generic forM coming from its ForM instance, so the identification is rfl. Purely definitional; the monad structure is carried along but does nothing.

proof_0101.moves: Not a proof: this is the automatically generated projection extracting the `out` field of the class PreservesColimitOfIsReflexivePair. There is no mathematical step; the only thing one could name is the structure being projected.

proof_0102.moves: Negation on a quaternion algebra is defined componentwise, so the imI component of -a is by definition -(a.imI); rfl. The real content is the definition of the Neg instance, not any lemma.

proof_0103.moves: Not a proof: this is the projection of the `add_left` axiom field out of the InnerProductSpace class (additivity of the inner product in the first slot is an assumed axiom). No step to explain.

proof_0104.moves: The graded-one instance on the constant family (fun _ => R) is defined with one := 1, so its GOne.one field is literally 1; rfl. Content is the definition of the instance being unfolded.

proof_0105.moves: From -x ∈ s and y ∈ s, closure under multiplication gives (-x) * y ∈ s; then rewrite (-x) * y = -(x * y) using neg_mul. Two real lemmas, glued by simp.

proof_0106.moves: Not a proof: the auto-generated parent projection witnessing that LatticeHomClass extends InfHomClass. The only content is the class hierarchy declaration itself.

proof_0107.moves: The coercion of a set to a sort is by definition the subtype {x // x ∈ S}, so coercing the set-builder {x | x ∈ S} gives that subtype on the nose; rfl. Purely unfolding Set.Elem and the set-builder.

proof_0108.moves: intersperse is defined by pattern matching, and the one-element case [x] falls into the branch returning [x] unchanged; rfl. The content is which defining equation of intersperse fires.

proof_0109.moves: The bipointed type obtained from a two-pointed type is built on the same carrier, so the two coercions to Sort are definitionally equal; rfl. Only carrier projections are unfolded.

proof_0110.moves: Commute the two factors so the expression matches the already-proved cancellation a / b * (b / c) = a / c, then apply that lemma. Exactly two mathematical steps: mul_comm, then div_mul_div_cancel.

proof_0111.moves: Use the characterization a::l ⊆ m ↔ a ∈ m ∧ l ⊆ m in the backwards direction, feeding it the pair of the two hypotheses. The whole proof is packaging the two hypotheses into a conjunction and applying the iff.

proof_0112.moves: Case split on the Option: for none both sides reduce to true, for some a both sides reduce to p applied through f. The content is the case analysis plus definitional computation of bind and all; the rest is simp residue.

proof_0113.moves: On the order dual, ≤ is reversed while multiplication is unchanged, so right-cancellation of ≤ for the dual is the same statement as contravariance for the swapped multiplication on the original order; flip the base instance's field through Contravariant.flip and package it with the class constructor.

proof_0114.moves: The multicospan shape attached to a 1-hypercover is defined by @[simps]-style fields, and its `snd` field is literally j.1.2; so the simp lemma holds by rfl. Pure projection unfolding.

proof_0115.moves: To show 0 is additively cancellable for ≤: rewrite 0 + a and 0 + b down to a and b using zero_add, after which the required implication is the identity. One real lemma (zero_add) plus the identity function; everything else is simp's congruence scaffolding.

proof_0116.moves: The action of an additive unit on a type is by definition the action of its underlying element, so commutation of the two actions transfers verbatim from the base commutation axiom; build the instance with that field.

proof_0117.moves: The identity morphism of a frame object has underlying frame hom the identity, which applied to x gives x; closed by simp. The genuinely used facts are the hom_id lemma and the identity-application lemma, neither of which appears here — the listed items are simp's `of_eq_true`/`eq_self` residue.

proof_0118.moves: Not a proof: the projection extracting the `property` field from the Hom structure of an induced wide category (a morphism there is by construction a morphism of D satisfying P). Nothing to argue.

proof_0119.moves: Take x with a < x and conclude a ≤ x; the entire proof is membership unfolding plus le_of_lt applied to the hypothesis.

proof_0120.moves: Case split on the outer Option: for none both sides are none, for some y both sides reduce to y.map f. The case analysis plus definitional reduction of map and join is the whole argument.
